description: This header file defines utility functions for synchronizing and persisting files, particularly JSON settings, in the Utils namespace. It provides inline functions to handle file synchronization and JSON setting persistence, utilizing core system calls and a JSON framework.

methods.name: void syncPersistFile(const string file)
methods.description: Synchronizes a file by opening it, flushing its buffers, syncing to disk, and then closing it.

methods.name: void persistJsonSettings(const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
methods.description: Persists a JSON setting to a file by reading existing JSON content, updating it with a new key-value pair, and ensuring the file is synchronized to disk.
